Our story

From Coconut to Bottle

KMP'S TRADERS is a family business in Cheruvannur, Kerala. It runs KMP Oil Mill, which makes coconut oil, and the KMP Coconut Grinding Centre, which supplies coconut milk, ground coconut and roasted coconut.

  1. 1Sourcing

    Whole coconuts are where every product begins.

  2. 2Preparation

    Coconuts are opened and readied for grinding.

  3. 3Production

    Ground, milled or roasted, depending on the product.

  4. 4Packing

    Coconut oil is bottled in 200 ml, 500 ml and 1 litre sizes.

Why choose us

Simple, local and made with care

  • Traditionally produced
